title: Use of `structuredClone` breaks Vue implementation
description:
### Description

When using the `@ai-sdk/vue` implementation, `messages` and therefore `message` objects themselves are _reactive_ which in Vue3 is implemented using Proxies.

However, `structuredClone` by itself does not work on Proxies:
https://github.com/vuejs/core/issues/8975
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_Workers_API/Structured_clone_algorithm#supported_types

It is used here:
https://github.com/vercel/ai/commit/0d2d9bf178f68fe8897fc4c93845be86c893c21f
@lgrammel 




### Code example

Any code that uses `useChat` in `@ai-sdk/vue` and uses multi-step and client tools.

### AI provider

Any

### Additional context

Error on the browser is:

```
CalendarBotWidget.vue:21 onError DataCloneError: Failed to execute 'structuredClone' on 'Window': #<Object> could not be cloned.
    at processChatResponse (@ai-sdk_vue.js?v=8d47b7d5:1061:40)
    at callChatApi (@ai-sdk_vue.js?v=8d47b7d5:1309:13)
    at async triggerRequest (@ai-sdk_vue.js?v=8d47b7d5:2235:7)
    at async triggerRequest (@ai-sdk_vue.js?v=8d47b7d5:2297:7)
```
